• must_move_first_touched_piece (chess, institutional): the player must move the first piece touched that can be moved
  ⇐ MustMoveFirstTouchedPiece (chess): Article 4.3.1. If the player having the move touches one or more of his/her own pieces, he/she must move the first piece touched that can be moved
      § FIDE_ART_4 (article/4)
    • own_piece_of (chess, empirical): the piece belongs to the player
    • piece_touched_intentionally (chess, judgment): the player having the move touched the piece with the intention of moving or capturing
        (no producers in the world)
    • piece_can_be_moved (chess, empirical): the piece can be moved
    • player_has_the_move (chess, empirical): the player has the move
